name: Ownership bank account

ownership_id.label: Ownership
ownership_id.description: Ownership allowed to use the bank account.

description.label: Description
description.help: The value is computed from the ownership.

ownership_code.label: Ownership code
ownership_code.help: The value is computed from the ownership.

allowed_owner_identity_ids.label: Allowed identities
allowed_owner_identity_ids.description: Owners and external representative allowed for the account.
allowed_owner_identity_ids.help: This list restricts the identities that can be selected.

owner_identity_id.label: Account holder
owner_identity_id.description: Owner or external representative holding the account.
owner_identity_id.help: The identity must belong to the ownership or be its external representative.

bank_account_id.label: Bank account
bank_account_id.description: Bank account made available to the ownership.

bank_account_type.label: Account type
bank_account_type.description: Type of the linked bank account.
bank_account_type.help: The value is computed from the bank account.

bank_account_iban.label: IBAN
bank_account_iban.description: IBAN of the linked bank account.

bank_account_bic.label: BIC

bank_account_bic.help: The value is computed from the bank account.

bank_account_suffix.label: Suffix
bank_account_suffix.description: Suffix of the linked bank account.
bank_account_suffix.help: The value is computed from the bank account.

bank_country.label: Country
bank_country.description: Country of the linked bank account.
bank_country.help: The value is computed from the IBAN.

bank_name.label: Bank
bank_name.description: Name of the bank holding the linked account.
bank_name.help: The value is computed from the IBAN.

bank_id.label: Bank
bank_id.description: Bank associated with the linked account.
bank_id.help: The value is computed from the bank account.

is_active.label: Active
is_active.description: Indicates whether the linked bank account is active.
is_active.help: An inactive account should no longer be used.

is_primary.label: Primary account
is_primary.description: Indicates the preferred account for the ownership.
is_primary.help: The primary account is preferred for refunds.

accounting_account_id.label: Accounting account
accounting_account_id.description: Accounting account associated with the bank account type.
accounting_account_id.help: The value is determined from the condominium and account type.

is_validated.label: Validated account
is_validated.description: Indicates that the ownership confirmed the bank account.
is_validated.help: Only confirmed accounts should be used for refunds.
